efficientnet_b0.train:
Compose(
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-10.0, 10.0], interpolation=bilinear, expand=False, fill=0)
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.9, 1.1), contrast=None, saturation=None, hue=None)
    ImageClassification(
    crop_size=[224]
    resize_size=[256]
    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
    std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    interpolation=InterpolationMode.BICUBIC
)
)
efficientnet_b0.evaluation:
ImageClassification(
    crop_size=[224]
    resize_size=[256]
    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
    std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    interpolation=InterpolationMode.BICUBIC
)
